summary: Marketing automation platform for email, SMS and customer data.
access_note: Private API keys created in account settings; OAuth is intended for tech partners.
blocker_note: Multi-tenant OAuth is recommended for tech partners and may need partner registration; private keys work immediately.

evidence.quote: Private API keys can be used to read and write data to your Klaviyo account
To manage API keys, you must have an Owner, Admin, or Manager role on your Klaviyo account
Every endpoint in the Klaviyo REST API, with its authentication, parameters, request and response bodies, and an example request

notes: Private keys are self-serve for Owner/Admin/Manager roles; OAuth is recommended for tech partners and may need partner approval (not verified). Hosted MCP requires Owner/Admin/Manager role. Free API access on the free plan not separately verified.

review.reason: Old access quote was about OAuth for tech partners and did not prove self-serve access; replaced with the key-creation role requirement and the pricing page free start.
